mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants price in near-term economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing contractions signals reduced real economic activity that depresses corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 380,000 million dollars (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to strong near-term economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 380,000.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 3.0% signals monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Employment levels above 137,000 thousand (PAYEMS) indicate a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 137,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants price in near-term economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.
